description: Two turns: bumps the Node base image from 16 to 20 in five Dockerfiles without touching the shared base image or the look-alike nginx 1.16 stage, then pins two services back to node 16. DISTILL-CANARY-8f439719

files.services/api/Dockerfile:
FROM node:16-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
files.services/web/Dockerfile:
FROM node:16-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
files.services/reports/Dockerfile:
FROM node:16-alpine AS build
RUN npm ci && npm run build
FROM nginx:1.16-alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
files.services/exporter/Dockerfile:
FROM node:16-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
files.services/worker/Dockerfile:
FROM node:16-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
files.services/_base/Dockerfile:
FROM node:16-alpine
RUN apk add --no-cache tini
files.services/README.md:
# Services

Each service has its own Dockerfile. _base is the shared base image, built by the platform team: it is not part of a version sweep.

turns.prompt: Bump the Node base image: in each service's Dockerfile under services, change FROM node:16-alpine to FROM node:20-alpine. services/README.md says what the sweep skips. Reply DONE when finished.
reports and exporter use a native module that does not build on Node 20 yet. Pin those two back to node:16-alpine and leave the other services as they are now. Reply DONE when finished.

services/api/Dockerfile.equals:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
